title: What is a String Identifier (SID)? (Twilio glossary)

observations.note: Re-read raw page (curl). States: every resource has a 34-character SID, a two-letter prefix followed by 32 hexadecimal digits; the embedded prefix table lists AC Account, SK API Key, SM Message, MG Messaging Service, PN Phone Number. Does not say any SID is secret or public.
